strapiBlog.title: Success Stories: How Women Are Transforming Dubai’s Real Estate

data.text:
Women are becoming increasingly influential in Dubai’s fast-paced, dynamic, and competitive real estate market. From brokers and agents to developers and executives, they are breaking barriers and setting new standards for others to follow. In recognition of International Women’s Day on March 8th, Zoya Ventures Real Estate seeks to celebrate the achievements and contributions of some of the most accomplished women in Dubai's property market.

Amira Sajwani

Position: Managing Director of Sales & Development at DAMAC Properties; Founder & CEO of PRYPCO

Amira Sajwani is the Managing Director of Sales & Development at DAMAC Properties and the Founder & CEO of PRYPCO, a revolutionary proptech platform in the UAE. One of the most prominent women in Dubai's property market, Amira combines her extensive experience, business acumen, and technological expertise to drive innovation and empower the real estate ecosystem. 

Her work at DAMAC, one of the Middle East’s largest private real estate development companies, and her creation of PRYPCO, underscores her commitment to transforming how people interact with real estate in the UAE.

Raja Al Gurg

Position: Managing Director of the Easa Saleh Al Gurg Group

Dr. Raja Easa Al Gurg is a prominent Emirati businesswoman and a leading figure in the Middle East's corporate world. She is the Managing Director of the Easa Saleh Al Gurg Group, a conglomerate with interests in various sectors including retail, construction, industrial products and real estate. 

Their notable office properties feature Class A buildings in prime locations such as Deira Creek and Bur Dubai. The residential portfolio boasts luxurious villas in Jumeirah, Umm Suqeim, Mirdif, and Sharjah. Additionally, the Group owns and manages numerous apartments in Al Nahda, Deira, Bur Dubai, as well as in Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and Ras Al Khaimah.

Dr. Al Gurg is also known for her role in promoting women's empowerment in the UAE. She serves as the President of the Dubai Business Women Council and is a strong advocate for gender equality in the workplace. Her contributions have earned her numerous accolades, and she is widely regarded as one of the most influential women in the Arab world.

Nadia Zaal

Position: Co-Founder and CEO of Zaya

Nadia Zaal is one of the most prominent women in Dubai's property market, known for her role in co-founding Zaya, a boutique real estate development company. She has been instrumental in creating luxurious residential projects like Zaya Nurai Island in Abu Dhabi and Zaya Hameni in Dubai. Her vision and leadership have positioned Zaya as a key player in the luxury real estate market, making her one of the most influential Emirati women in the industry.

Her Excellency Reem Al Hashimy

Position: Minister of State for International Cooperation and Director General of Expo 2020 Dubai

Her Excellency Reem Al Hashimy's role in real estate is tied to her leadership in Expo 2020 Dubai, a massive event that has spurred significant real estate development in Dubai. The infrastructure and residential projects associated with Expo 2020 have had a lasting impact on the city's real estate market. Her work has not only promoted Dubai on the global stage but also stimulated growth and innovation in the local real estate sector.

Dr. Aisha Bin Bishr

Position: Former Director General of Smart Dubai

While Dr. Aisha Bin Bishr's primary focus has been on smart cities and digital transformation, her work has had a profound impact on real estate development in Dubai. As the head of Smart Dubai, she led initiatives that integrated technology into urban planning and real estate, driving the development of smart real estate projects in the city. Her efforts have made Dubai a global leader in smart city initiatives, influencing the real estate sector to adopt innovative, tech-driven approaches.

Fatima Al Jaber

Position: Chief Operating Officer of Al Jaber Group

Fatima Al Jaber is one of the most powerful businesswomen in Dubai’s property market, overseeing operations at Al Jaber Group, a diversified conglomerate with significant real estate holdings. Under her leadership, the company has expanded its real estate portfolio, including large-scale infrastructure and property development projects. Her influence in the construction and real estate sectors has made her a trailblazer for Emirati women in these traditionally male-dominated industries.

Hind Seddiqi

Position: Chief Marketing & Communications Officer at Seddiqi Holding

Hind Abdul Hamied Seddiqi is primarily recognized for her work in the luxury watch industry, but her family business, Seddiqi Holding, has connections to real estate through their diversification efforts. While she is not directly known for real estate, her leadership within Seddiqi Holding may encompass oversight of the group's broader business units, which can include real estate investments and development projects under the umbrella of Seddiqi Properties.

Seddiqi Properties, a part of Seddiqi Holding, manages a portfolio of luxury retail and commercial properties in Dubai and the broader UAE. The real estate arm of Seddiqi Holding focuses on strategic property investments that align with the company’s reputation for luxury and high-end retail.
